integrity: The universal result is proved analytically; exact-rational checking is bounded to all ordered proper binary trees with at most seven leaves. Literature priority has a residual unindexed-result risk; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite rooted proper binary trees, fair conditional probabilities, real scalar Haar signs and atomic L-infinity only. No assertion for unequal split masses, suppression multipliers, infinite filtrations, non-Haar local bases or general Lp.
title: Depth-only endpoint unconditionality and exact dimension spectrum of adaptive Haar trees
